name: task_demo
notes: SIM-AUTHORED, NOT A RECORDED DEMONSTRATION. FACTS.md says HARDWARE_PRESENT: no (no CANable attached), so there was no arm to teach this on and no human demo was replayed into it. It is a hand-written slow tabletop pick-and-place of a plastic bottle (approach, open, descend, grasp, lift, transfer, place, release, retreat, home), authored inside yam.arm's joint limits, that exists to give the tier=act beat something honest to animate. The arm's entire repertoire is this one trajectory — say so on stage. joint3 does the lifting and joint2 stays small, per yam.arm's self-collision notes. The gripper channel is SIM-ONLY (percent open): yam.arm.ARM_JOINTS excludes the gripper because its jaw travel is uncalibrated on this robot, so on hardware this trajectory runs as a six-joint reach with the jaws untouched. Pose set is NOT collision-verified: run yam.environment.ArmSafetyChecker before the first hardware run.
